exercises.instruction: Each line gives what Karen said ten years ago, then (after the slash) what she says today. Write about how Karen has changed. Use used to / didn’t use to / never used to in the first part of your sentence.

items.prompt: I travel a lot. / I don’t go away much these days.
answers: She used to travel a lot, but she doesn’t go away much these days.

items.prompt: I’m very lazy. / I work very hard these days.
answers: She used to be very lazy, but she works very hard these days.

items.prompt: I don’t like cheese. / I eat lots of cheese now.
answers: She didn’t use to like cheese, but she eats lots of cheese now.
She used not to like cheese, but she eats lots of cheese now.

items.prompt: I play the piano. / I haven’t played the piano for a long time.
answers: She used to play the piano, but she hasn’t played the piano for a long time.
She used to play the piano, but she hasn’t played it for a long time.

items.prompt: I never drink tea. / Tea’s great! I like it now.
answers: She didn’t use to drink tea, but she likes it now.
She used not to drink tea, but she likes it now.

items.prompt: I have a dog. / My dog died two years ago.
answers: She used to have a dog, but it died two years ago.

exercises.instruction: Write about how you have changed. In 1–5 begin with I used to …, in 6–8 with I didn’t use to …, and finish with but … and how things are now. Read the descriptions for ideas.
exercises.scene:
For example:
I used to live in a small village, but now I live in a city.
I didn’t use to read a lot, but I do now.

items.cue: 🏠 where you lived or went to school
modelAnswers: I used to live in a small village, but now I live in a city.

items.cue: ⚽ a sport, game or hobby you’ve given up
modelAnswers: I used to play tennis a lot, but I don’t play any more.

items.cue: 🍽️ food: something you ate, or never ate
modelAnswers: I used to be a vegetarian, but now I eat meat sometimes.
I used to watch TV a lot, but I don’t watch it much now.

items.cue: 😴 something you hated or found hard
modelAnswers: I used to hate getting up early, but now it’s no problem.
I didn’t use to read a lot, but I do now.

items.cue: ☕ something you eat or drink every day now
modelAnswers: I didn’t use to drink coffee, but I drink it every day now.

items.cue: ☀️ something you enjoy now: weather, music, places
modelAnswers: I didn’t use to like hot weather, but now I love it.
